description: Single storey rear extension; alterations and extension to roof to form end gable; rear dormer; window in end gable; two roof lights in front roof slope; rear patio with steps and privacy panel; external alterations
decision_conditions:
The loft level window(s) in the eastern  elevation(s) of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Flood
Risk

The
development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the flood
risk mitigation and resilience measures set out within the Flood Risk
Assessment prepared by WtFR Ltd dated 31 May 2026. The measures shall
thereafter be retained.

Drainage

Prior to
first use of the extension, any hardstanding replaced as part of the
development shall be of permeable construction and the water butt specified
within the Flood Risk Assessment prepared by WtFR Ltd dated 31 May 2026 shall
be installed. The measures shall thereafter be retained and maintained.
